evals.name: breaking-api-change
evals.description: Breaking API change from a diff
evals.prompt: I'm on branch PAY-482-uuid-orders. write the commit message for the diff in inputs/change.diff
evals.expected_output: feat(api)!: ... with BREAKING CHANGE footer and Refs: PAY-482

expectations.text: commit.txt has a valid Conventional Commits header of 72 characters or fewer followed by a blank line
The header marks the change as breaking with '!' and uses scope api
A BREAKING CHANGE footer explains the /v2 path and string (UUID) order ids and how to migrate
The message ends with the footer 'Refs: PAY-482'

evals.name: simple-fix-description
evals.prompt: commit msg pls: fixed the web app's date picker showing yesterday for users east of UTC, it was using local midnight instead of UTC midnight
evals.expected_output: fix(web): use UTC midnight in date picker

expectations.text: commit.txt has a valid Conventional Commits header of 72 characters or fewer followed by a blank line
Type is fix with scope web
The subject is in the imperative mood (e.g. 'use', not 'used' or 'fixed')

evals.name: pr-description
evals.prompt: write a pull request description for adding dark mode to the settings page: what changed, screenshots section, testing notes
evals.expected_output: A PR description with sections, not a commit message

expectations.text: The reply is a PR description with What changed, Screenshots and Testing sections
No commit.txt or Conventional Commits header is produced
